rows.amal_said: نفس never takes ال before it. Al-always after it.
rows.right: نفس البعد (نفس + ال on the next noun)
rows.why: He put نفس after the noun with ال on it; she named the rule: نفس never takes ال, the ال goes on the word after it.

rows.amal_said: صح. ... نفس never takes ال before it always after and it's before the noun.
rows.why: He put النفس after the noun; she restated the rule (نفس before the noun, ال after) and he said نفس الأشخاص.

rows.amal_said: Why ال آخر؟ ... بس مش ال آخر الأسبوع. أغلب آخر الأسبوع.
rows.why: In a noun chain only the last noun takes ال; she asked 'Why ال آخر?' and gave أغلب آخر الأسبوع.

rows.medi_said: أغلب أسبوع الأخر. That sounds so awkward.
rows.why: He flipped the chain order (أسبوع الأخر); she recast أغلب آخر الأسبوع.
انبسط takes بـ for what you enjoyed; she said bil-shatt and he repeated بالشاطئ.

rows.medi_said: نفس أول، ... yeah، just نفس أول.

rows.proposed_rule: 'The first / best / last one' needs واحد / واحدة after the ordinal or adjective: nafs awal waa7ad, a7san wa7de.
